voice_and_tone_rules: Second person, literal, present tense, short. The found-diary voice appears only on milestone pages (2026-09-09: 'Direct, diary only on milestones (Recommended)'; written down at docs/FEATURES.md:6602-6604).

Literal, not cryptic or mysterious in an 'AI' way. 2026-09-04: 'i hate the flvour text on the quests. it doenst sound human.  be a bit more literal rather than crytic all the time'. 2026-09-03: 'sounds quite AI... a little less mysterious vibe, more practical advice mixed with there is more to learn yet'.

Don't end every entry on a hedge or open question. The 'never worked out X' pattern was dropped on 2026-09-04/06. Keep an open question only where it is literally true, for example that the endless phase has no ceiling.

Snappy, and no inventories of contents. 2026-09-09 (Open It): 'make it snappier, dont need to list all the loot bag types'. 2026-09-10 (Last Written Wave): 'too verbose... remove all the info on mobs are going to spawn'. 2026-09-28: 'The last written wav quest text is terrible'. 2026-09-30: 'past the line quest text is too verbose'.

Hint, don't tell. Borrowed Time should say 'the gear looks battered, notched in places. more of a hint' (2026-09-05). Boss quests carry no specifics: 'the behemoth quest again as too much spoliers in it' (2026-09-10). Don't state the exact endless scaling numbers (fixed 2026-09-09) or the wave-gap lengths (2026-09-28).
Don't describe loot or contents that can change. 2026-09-11: 'the quest the last written wave speaks to the loot of the suppy crate this is now different. can you just remove this bit of the text'.

Describe mechanics accurately and read every number from the code. The user has caught wrong text before: the spikes-plus-web combo on 2026-09-05 ('have I missed something'), the pedestal heal on 2026-09-09 ('the item goes on the pedestal then disappears. I dont want it work like that'), and the '4 minutes' wave-gap claim on 2026-09-28 ('this is wrong').

Vocabulary: 'Wave N' for waves 1-8 and 'Horde N' after that (2026-09-10: 'rename this and any other new wave popup to you the horde vocab'). In the fiction the diary stops at wave 8 ('The Last Written Wave').
Theme: Fallout-TV wasteland with a DIY scavenger feel, framed as 'a dear diary left over from a previous unfortuate soul' (2026-08-19).
One item per quest, never a wall of text (2026-08-30).

Use colour codes sparingly (&e on item names, &c on warnings) and only inside descriptions. Formatting in chapter titles produced 'invalid formatting' errors twice (2026-09-05 item 8, 2026-09-08 item 2).
Use the user's own names: they call the Culinary Generator the 'bio generator' (2026-09-11).
